episodes.synopsis: A space shuttle sent to the Moon has recovered parts of heretical technology as well as the body of Dr. Nastassja, but a collision with space debris threatens to send it crashing into a mountain. Will the Symphogear wielders be able to use their songs to stop the collision in time?
episodes.title: Murderer of Miracles

episodes.synopsis: A mysterious enemy has struck simultaneously in Japan and London, where Tsubasa is performing a concert. Their power is even greater than that of the Symphogears, and they want to destroy the entire world.
episodes.title: Before I Destroy the World

episodes.synopsis: The Autoscorers destroy two of the Symphogears, disabling the team. Now only Hibiki is left, and she's refusing to fight.
episodes.title: Twilight of the Wielders

episodes.synopsis: With most of the Symphogears destroyed, it's up to Hibiki to fight the Autoscorers. But she's scared of hurting someone, and can't sing. Will she be able to find the will to fight?
episodes.title: Gungnir, Once More

episodes.synopsis: Almost every Symphogear wielder's gear is destroyed, and it seems there's no one left who can fight back. Elfnein has a plan, but before it can be carried out the Autoscorers attack S.O.N.G headquarters! It's up to Kirika and Shirabe to save the day, and they can barely transform...
episodes.title: Edge Works

episodes.synopsis: The Autoscorers are attacking SONG headquarters, and there are no function Symphogears left to stop them. Kirika and Shirabe have been defeated, and Tsubasa and Chris have only one chance left: to use the new Ignite Module system and hope they can retain control.
episodes.title: Drawn Blade

episodes.synopsis: Everyone decides to go to beach for "training". While they're having a good time, the Autoscorers attack, and Maria is forced to fight them despite her weakened state.
episodes.title: Carry On the Shining Light, and Stay True to Yourself

episodes.synopsis: Hibiki is badly shaken up after her meeting with her father. She's so shaken up that even during the Autoscorer fight she can't focus properly, and Kirika and Shirabe have to protect her.
episodes.title: The Courage to Face It

episodes.synopsis: The Autoscorers' goal is revealed, and the Symphogear wielders must split up to stop them. Tsubasa visits her dad's house, while Hibiki is still uncertain about her own father.
episodes.title: The Middle of a Dream

episodes.synopsis: Dr. Ver is back, and the truth behind Carol's plot is revealed. Will the Symphogear wielders be able to stop them in time?
episodes.title: It's So Cruel, But...

episodes.synopsis: Carol's World Destructor device is complete, and she's ready to dissect the world. Will the Symphogear wielders be able to stop her in time?
episodes.title: It's All Right. Everything Is Just Fine

episodes.synopsis: Maria, Shirabe, and Kirika infiltrate the Château de Tiffauges to stop the world from disintegrating.
episodes.title: GX

episodes.synopsis: Carol now has the power of 7 billion Superb Songs. Will the Symphogears be able to stop her with their new S2CA-Hexa Burst?
episodes.title: Believe in Justice, and Hold It Close
